title: Binary digits of a natural number
statement: For natural numbers $w$ and $v$, the list of binary digits of $v$ of width $w$ is the list, in increasing order of bit position from $0$ to $w-1$, whose entry at position $i$ is the $i$th binary digit of $v$.
